collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-30  -  THE YOUNG EXAMPLE SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A child notices that a communal drinking vessel has been left beside the path where someone might trip over it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A child notices that a communal drinking vessel has been left beside the path where someone might trip over it.

choices.label: Move It Carefully to Its Usual Place.
Ask Who Is Responsible for the Vessel.
Suggest Keeping the Path Clear During Busy Hours.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: An adult notices the thoughtful act and thanks the child.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The vessel is too heavy, so the child asks an adult to move it.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Several people step around the vessel until someone can move it.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The child grows tired of waiting and asks a nearby worker for assistance.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The keeper retrieves it and explains where it should be stored.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Nobody knows who left it, but the child helps ensure it is put away.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The workers agree to check the path when carrying supplies.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The suggestion is forgotten initially, but the child continues setting a careful example.
